backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Valentine music and UI requirements to implementation files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing high-level summaries for all frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling with OKLCH colors, fonts, and animation keyframes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML shell loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Simple entry component that renders ValentinePage.
frontend/src/components/Confetti.tsx: Generates animated falling heart confetti using randomized pieces.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with copyright text and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with Valentine branding and an optional music toggle button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors via react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Manages looping background audio with autoplay handling and persistent on/off state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity React context providing login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Lightweight hook exposing backend readiness state using useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables for light/dark modes, base styles, and custom animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/ValentinePage.tsx: Implements the interactive Valentine flow with yes/no logic, animations, sharing support, and celebration UI.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors from CSS variables, animations, fonts, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Describes project state, including requirements, features, issues, and architectural notes for the Valentine site.
